item.title: Sportswear Royalty Meets Football Royalty in Stone Island SS26 (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Pioneering Italian fashion brand Stone Island has Italian football’s greatest defender, Paolo Maldini, modeling for SS26. It is, as the locals say, fanatastico!

item.title: Nike's Scaley AF1 Shoes Hurt so Good
item.description: Scale-speckled and snake-colored, the Nike Air Force 1 ’07 PRM is a dangerously beautiful, beautifully dangerous reptile of a with sneaker.

item.title: Get in the Zone with Nike's Mind001 and Zalando
item.description: Zalando and Nike launched their Mind-Altering Experience at the Highsnobiety store in Berlin with NBA Legend Marc Gasol

item.title: Inside the Quiet Japanese Factory Powering Onitsuka Tiger’s Global Rise
item.description: While its younger peers lean into high-tech newness, Onitsuka Tiger is devoted to age-old craft.

item.title: AURALEE Proves That Good Clothes Aren't Boring (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: AURALEE's Fall/Winter 2026 collection epitomizes the Japanese brand's appeal, even overtly demonstrating its adventurous colors & styling.

item.title: Only Prada Could See This Much Potential In a Climbing Sneaker (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Prada's Speedrock sneaker is a social climber, in the sense that this bouldering-inspired shoe looks great in real-life night-out settings.

item.title: Lids’ New Daily Rotation Collection is an Excuse to Hit the Mall
item.description: Mall link-ups just hit different. With its new “Daily Rotation” collection, Lids is cementing its status within mall culture, curating a selection of fitteds that place personal style at the forefront.
